title: Debar
desc: A family's fate teeters when the eldest brother tragically dies while supporting his youngest sibling's education. The sibling then strives to honour his sacrifice and repay his sister-in-law.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Deewana
desc: A newlywed Kajal gets widowed when her husband, Ravi, is killed by his enemies. She moves to another city and gets married to Raja, but her life takes a turn when Ravi returns from the dead.

title: Ajker Santan
desc: Chandranath, a factory worker, dies trying to fund his daughter Rani's wedding. After his death, his biological children mistreat his family, while his adopted son Aninda shows true loyalty.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.

title: Rajar Meye Parul
desc: A childless king marries a woodcutter's daughter to gain an heir. However, his wives kill his seven children, leaving only his daughter Parul, who grows up to be a charming young lady.

title: Teen Murti
desc: Nabin, Nagen and Naren, three retired men, are the best of friends. Soon, they decide to revive an old tea shop and make some profits.
